question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH 
-- Wholesale data per item per year
wholesale_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(whsle_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as year,
        item_code,
        AVG("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN("whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(whsle_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)
    GROUP BY year, item_code
),

-- Selling data per item per year (only sales, not returns)
selling_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as year,
        item_code,
        SUM("qty_sold(kg)" * "unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_value
    FROM veg_txn_df
    WHERE "sale/return" = 'sale'
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)
    GROUP BY year, item_code
),

-- Loss rates per item
item_loss_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        item_code,
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
    GROUP BY item_code
),

-- Combine all data
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        w.year,
        w.item_code,
        c.category_name,
        w.avg_wholesale_price,
        w.max_wholesale_price,
        w.min_wholesale_price,
        w.max_wholesale_price - w.min_wholesale_price as wholesale_price_difference,
        COALESCE(s.total_selling_value, 0) as total_selling_value,
        r.avg_loss_rate
    FROM wholesale_yearly w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    LEFT JOIN selling_yearly s ON w.year = s.year AND w.item_code = s.item_code
    LEFT JOIN item_loss_rates r ON w.item_code = r.item_code
)

SELECT 
    category_name,
    year,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_wholesale_price), 2) as average_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(AVG(max_wholesale_price), 2) as maximum_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(AVG(min_wholesale_price), 2) as minimum_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(AVG(wholesale_price_difference), 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_value), 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_value), 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_loss_rate), 2) as average_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_value) * AVG(avg_loss_rate) / 100, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_value) * (1 - AVG(avg_loss_rate) / 100), 2) as profit
FROM combined
GROUP BY category_name, year
ORDER BY year, category_name
